from pydantic import BaseModel

# Step 1: Get all restaurants in Paris
restaurants_str = get_all_restaurants_in_city("Paris")
restaurants = restaurants_str.splitlines()

# Step 2: Get cuisine types for all restaurants
cuisine_types = get_cuisine_type_for_restaurants(restaurants)

# Step 3: Filter for French cuisine restaurants
french_restaurants = [name for name in restaurants if cuisine_types.get(name, "").lower() == "french"]

# Step 4: Get opening hours for French restaurants
opening_hours = check_restaurant_opening_hours(french_restaurants)

# Step 5: Find which French restaurants are open on Sunday
class OpenOnSundayModel(BaseModel):
    open_on_sunday: list[str]

    "Given the following restaurant opening hours, list the names of the restaurants that are open on Sunday. Only include those open on Sunday.",
    OpenOnSundayModel,
    opening_hours
).open_on_sunday

# Step 6: Get ratings and reviews for those open on Sunday
ratings_reviews = get_rating_reviews_for_restaurants(open_on_sunday)

# Step 7: Find the restaurant with the best rating and reviews

    name: str

best_restaurant_name = query_ai_assistant(
    "Given the following restaurants with their ratings and reviews, select the one with the best rating and reviews. Return only the restaurant name.",
    BestRestaurantModel,
    ratings_reviews
).name

# Step 8: Get address and operating hours for the best restaurant
address = get_restaurants_address([best_restaurant_name]).get(best_restaurant_name)
operating_hours = opening_hours.get(best_restaurant_name)
rating_review = ratings_reviews.get(best_restaurant_name)

# Step 9: Extract the rating from the review text
class RatingModel(BaseModel):
    rating: str

rating = query_ai_assistant(
    f"Extract only the rating (as a string) from the following review text: {rating_review}",
    RatingModel
).rating

# Step 10: Print the result
print(
    "Recommended French restaurant in Paris open on Sunday:\n"
    f"Name: {best_restaurant_name}\n"
    f"Rating: {rating}\n"
    f"Address: {address}\n"
    f"Operating Hours: {operating_hours}"
)
